summary: The proposed universal bound E_Z ||p_{Y|Z}||_infinity^(2/3)<=C for a 3-D spectral core is false. For three disjoint m-coordinate uniform cube blocks and block-constant spectral directions, the moment is exactly m^2 Gamma(4/3)^3 [Gamma(m)/Gamma(m+1/3)]^3 >= Gamma(4/3)^3 m. The same obstruction persists for A with spectrum {1,1,-1,tau,...,tau}, tau>=1. This refutes only the conditional-cap bridge, not QFORM. The same family is uniformly controlled by the completed account04/B18 physical Schur theorem with ||p_Q||_infinity<=2sqrt(pi).
